# Tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.mjs from the built server. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run docs:tools`. -->

Osseo registers 89 tools. Clients see the **14-tool default set** below (`tools.profile: "desktop"`).
Every other tool stays callable by name; set `tools.profile: "full"` (or `OSSEO_TOOLS_PROFILE=full`) to list them all.
Each call passes the same safety path: schema check, Stop and pause gates, a preview, an approval when the action is consequential, then the audit log.

## Default set

| Tool | What it does | Inputs (bold = required) |
|---|---|---|
| `guide.show` | Guide mode: draws a highlight box and a text label on each place the person should click. | **steps**, windowId, ttlSeconds, waitForClick, waitSeconds |
| `guide.clear` | Removes every mark guide.show drew in this session. | none |
| `see` | Lists what can be acted on in a window as numbered lines: [1] button "Save", [2] entry "Name" = "Ada". | window, filter, max, picture |
| `click` | Clicks element n from see, or the pixel x,y of the picture see returned (space: "screen" for raw screen pixels). | view, n, x, y, space, button, double |
| `type` | Types text into element n from see, replacing its text (clear: false appends) and reading it back. | view, n, **text**, clear, submit |
| `key` | Presses a key or chord in the active window, for example ["ctrl","l"] or "Return". | keys, sequence, repeat |
| `scroll` | Scrolls up, down, left or right over element n from see, over x,y, or at the pointer. | view, n, x, y, space, **direction**, amount |
| `drag` | Drags from element fromN (or fromX,fromY) to element toN (or toX,toY). | view, fromN, fromX, fromY, toN, toX, toY, space |
| `open` | Opens an app by name, or a url. | app, url, in |
| `windows` | Lists open windows (id, app, title), or focuses the window whose id is given in focus. | focus |
| `wait` | Waits until text appears (text), a window with that title appears (window), or text/a window goes away (gone). | text, window, gone, timeoutMs |
| `ask` | Hands a step to the person: login, mfa, captcha, payment or other. | **kind**, **message** |
| `steps` | Runs up to 20 tool calls in order as one governed plan (same input as computer.run_steps). | **steps**, stopOnError, returnScreenshot |
| `status` | Reports whether the agent is stopped, paused or in a takeover, and the active task. | none |

## All tools

### System

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `system.get_info` | Returns local system information and Osseo runtime details. |
| `system.list_capabilities` | Lists Osseo strategies, tools, and registered app capabilities. |
| `system.check_dependency` | Checks whether a command or desktop app appears to be available. |

### Vision helpers

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `vision.analyze_image` | Runs bounded local OCR on an approved screenshot or output image; never clicks. |
| `vision.find_text` | Finds bounded redacted OCR text and image-relative centers; never clicks. |
| `vision.find_target` | Ranks visible OCR target candidates with image-relative coordinates; never clicks or types. |
| `vision.find_text_on_screen` | Captures a fresh full-screen image and returns OCR suggestions in absolute screen coordinates; never clicks or types. |

### Shell

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `shell.run` | Runs a shell command with safety checks. |

### Files

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `file.read` | Reads a file from an approved path. |
| `file.read_many` | Reads a bounded batch of approved files without requiring one tool call per file. |
| `file.write` | Writes a file to an approved path. |
| `file.list` | Lists files in a directory. |
| `file.search` | Searches bounded local text files under an approved directory; returns paths and line numbers only. |
| `file.exists` | Checks if a path exists. |
| `file.ensure_dir` | Ensures a directory exists. |
| `file.copy` | Copies a file. |
| `file.move` | Moves a file. |
| `file.delete` | Deletes a single file. |

### Desktop input and capture

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `desktop.screenshot` | Captures a PNG/JPEG screenshot to an approved local folder with optional region, scale, and JPEG quality. |
| `desktop.hotkey` | Sends a desktop hotkey when policy and active-window context allow it. |
| `desktop.type_text` | Types text into the active window when policy and active-window context allow it. |
| `desktop.set_field` | Sets a text field: focuses it (x and y, or a label), selects its text, pastes the new text, then reads the field back through AT-SPI. |
| `desktop.file_dialog_select` | Picks a file in an open file dialog: focuses the dialog (by windowId, or by dialogTitle when it is the only match), types the path into its location bar (ctrl+L, pasted), presses Return, and checks that the dialog closed. |
| `desktop.click` | Clicks at absolute screen coordinates (x, y), at a point in a desktop.screenshot picture (screenshotId, imageX, imageY), or on a visible control named by label inside the active window. |
| `desktop.pointer` | Performs pointer actions when policy and active-window context allow it: move_mouse, scroll (direction + amount, at x,y when given), double_click and right_click (at x,y), drag (startX/startY to endX/endY). |

### Screen reading

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `screen.read` | Outline of the active window from the accessibility tree: roles, names, enabled state and screen bounds, no text content, capped in bytes (default 2048). |

### Guide mode

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `guide.show` | Guide mode: draws a highlight box and a text label on each place the person should click. |
| `guide.clear` | Removes every mark guide.show drew in this session. |

### Numbered actions (the default set)

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `see` | Lists what can be acted on in a window as numbered lines: [1] button "Save", [2] entry "Name" = "Ada". |
| `click` | Clicks element n from see, or the pixel x,y of the picture see returned (space: "screen" for raw screen pixels). |
| `type` | Types text into element n from see, replacing its text (clear: false appends) and reading it back. |
| `key` | Presses a key or chord in the active window, for example ["ctrl","l"] or "Return". |
| `scroll` | Scrolls up, down, left or right over element n from see, over x,y, or at the pointer. |
| `drag` | Drags from element fromN (or fromX,fromY) to element toN (or toX,toY). |
| `open` | Opens an app by name, or a url. |
| `windows` | Lists open windows (id, app, title), or focuses the window whose id is given in focus. |
| `wait` | Waits until text appears (text), a window with that title appears (window), or text/a window goes away (gone). |
| `ask` | Hands a step to the person: login, mfa, captcha, payment or other. |
| `steps` | Runs up to 20 tool calls in order as one governed plan (same input as computer.run_steps). |
| `status` | Reports whether the agent is stopped, paused or in a takeover, and the active task. |

### Apps and links

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `app.open` | Launches an installed desktop app by name through its desktop entry or executable. |
| `app.open_url` | Opens an http(s) or file:// URL in the default handler, or in a new tab of a named browser (reusing its logged-in profile). |

### Waits, state and plans

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `computer.observe_state` | Observes current computer state: active window, screen geometry, desktop capabilities, optionally window list. |
| `computer.wait_for` | Polls active-window, window-appears, title, file, or screen conditions until they match (or timeout), returning a timestamped state snapshot and fingerprint. |
| `computer.wait` | Waits a fixed number of milliseconds (50-10000) for pages, animations, or apps to settle when no observable condition fits computer.wait_for. |
| `computer.run_steps` | Runs a bounded, governed plan of up to 20 Osseo tool calls with one plan-scoped approval for low/medium effects. |

### Tasks

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `task.create` | Creates a persistent task with a user goal and observable definition-of-done criteria. |
| `task.status` | Returns task state: goal, status, phase, current action, and recent events. |
| `task.update` | Updates an active task's phase and current action. |
| `task.update_status` | Pauses, resumes, completes, or cancels a task. |
| `task.add_event` | Adds a progress, observation, error, recovery, verification, or note event to a task log. |
| `task.list` | Lists persistent tasks, most recently updated first. |

### Stop, pause and hand-off

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `agent.status` | Reports stop, takeover, pause, and handoff state, the active task approval, and MCP server provenance. |
| `agent.stop` | Requests an emergency stop. |
| `agent.takeover_begin` | Marks human takeover. |
| `agent.request_handoff` | Ask the human to do a step the agent must not do itself: log in, enter an MFA code, solve a CAPTCHA, or approve a payment. |

### Windows

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `window.list` | Lists visible windows. |
| `window.focus` | Focuses a window by ID, app name, title, or PID. |

### Accessibility tree

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `ui.tree` | Reads the accessibility tree (roles, names, screen bounds, element ids) of an app or the active window. |
| `ui.find` | Finds UI elements by visible name/label (and optional role such as 'push button', 'entry', 'link') in an app or the active window. |
| `ui.activate` | Invokes an accessibility action (default 'click'/'press'/'activate') on one element found by elementId or query. |
| `ui.set_text` | Sets the text of an editable element (entry, text area, search box) through accessibility. |

### Clipboard

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `clipboard.set` | Places text on the system clipboard (for a later Ctrl+V or to hand the user a value). |
| `clipboard.get` | Reads the system clipboard text. |

### The agent's own browser (and the person's, through the extension)

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `browser.open` | Starts (or reuses) a dedicated Chrome window with its own profile and optionally loads a URL. |
| `browser.snapshot` | Lists the visible interactive elements of the current page (each with a ref such as s3-e12) and its visible text. |
| `browser.click` | Clicks an element by ref from the latest browser.snapshot, with a real mouse event at its centre. |
| `browser.type` | Types text into an input by ref from the latest browser.snapshot (optionally clearing it first, optionally pressing Enter). |
| `browser.navigate` | Loads a URL (goto) or moves through history (back, forward, reload) in the dedicated browser. |
| `browser.close` | Closes the dedicated browser. |
| `browser.upload` | Attaches local files to a file input found by ref in browser.snapshot, without opening a file dialog. |
| `browser.select` | Chooses an option of a <select> (by ref from browser.snapshot) by its value or visible label, and fires the input and change events the page expects. |
| `browser.wait_for` | Waits until text appears on the page, or the URL contains a string, up to timeoutMs (default 10 s). |
| `browser.fill` | Fills several inputs in one call, each by ref, then reads every value back and reports which ones took the text. |
| `browser.screenshot` | Returns a JPEG of the page, or of one element by ref, as an image in the reply. |
| `browser.own_tabs` | Lists the tabs of the person's own browser on hosts allowed by a site rule in policy.toml, as { tabId, host, title }. |
| `browser.own_snapshot` | Lists the interactive elements of a tab in the person's own browser (each with a ref such as s3-e12). |
| `browser.own_click` | Clicks an element by ref from browser.own_snapshot in the person's own browser. |
| `browser.own_type` | Types text into an input by ref in the person's own browser. |
| `browser.own_select` | Selects an option by value in a select element by ref in the person's own browser. |
| `browser.own_navigate` | Navigates a tab of the person's own browser to a url. |
| `browser.own_read` | Reads the visible text of a tab in the person's own browser. |

### Saved workflows

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `workflow.save` | Saves a plan that just worked as a named, reusable workflow. |
| `workflow.list` | Lists saved workflows with their parameters. |
| `workflow.get` | Returns a saved workflow's steps with parameters filled in. |
| `workflow.delete` | Deletes a saved workflow. |

### Lessons

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `memory.save` | Remembers one short lesson about HOW to work on this computer, for future sessions (for example, an app's quirk). |
| `memory.search` | Finds saved lessons by words or topic, newest first. |
| `memory.delete` | Deletes one saved lesson that turned out to be wrong. |
